thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: sustained high error rate and request surge for dedicated pool eu-prod-pool-9. autoscaler reached cap (16/16). 5xx ratio rising, routes impacted: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings.

tom (oncall): I'm taking this. dashboards show p95 at ~1.2s and errors climbing. any customer P1s?

hannah (support): one strategic customer reported frequent timeouts (tenant-gamma). others have slowness but no P1s yet.

yusuf (infra): autoscaler logs indicate cloud returns capacity_errors when requesting additional g5 slices. Pool config has burst disabled and max_nodes=16. We also see sudden load from a small set of tenants hitting rerank and long-context streams.

tom (oncall): immediate mitigations proposal: 1) enable burst for pool (short TTL) 2) apply short-term per-tenant token shaping on top consumers 3) reduce pool-level max_concurrency and temporarily turn off costly features (rerank/long-stream). Any objections?

elaine (dedicated-eng): agree. I can flip burst and feature gates. Burst multiplier=2 should be safe and quick; TTL 1800s. I can also lower max_concurrency via admin API.

yusuf (infra): I'll prepare rate-limit rules. Suggest per-tenant and per-route caps: heavy tenants get token caps and rerank route gets stricter limits. Also I'll open an emergency quota request with cloud.

tom (oncall): go ahead. paste commands so we have an audit trail. hannah, prep customer note. oliver, should product be informed for follow-ups?

oliver (product): yes please capture impacted tenants and decision rationale. we'll want to discuss reserved burst options for enterprise customers next week.

elaine (dedicated-eng): executing burst enable now:
```
# enable burst on pool eu-prod-pool-9
redwoodctl dedicated pool update --id eu-prod-pool-9 --burst_multiplier 2 --burst_ttl 1800
```
elaine (dedicated-eng): API response: 202 accepted. pool state -> enabling-burst.

deploy-bot: orchestration: provisioning additional capacity to eu-prod-pool-9 (burst).

yusuf (infra): applying rate-limiter rules:
```
# rate limit payload
{
  "scope":"tenant",
  "targets":["tenant-gamma","tenant-delta","tenant-epsilon"],
  "max_tokens_per_minute":9000,
  "behavior":"soft-429"
}
```

yusuf (infra): rules applied. route-based shaping also applied to /v1/rerank -> token cap 2000/min.

elaine (dedicated-eng): lowering pool concurrency:
```
PATCH /admin/pools/eu-prod-pool-9/config
{ "max_concurrency": 6 }
```
elaine (dedicated-eng): accepted. new concurrency effective immediately.

tom (oncall): monitoring... p95 dropped to ~420ms within a minute. errors down but not fully back to baseline. any cloud update?

yusuf (infra): cloud quota team acknowledged emergency request, promised short uplift for 1 hour while they review. filing for permanent quota increase now.

hannah (support): drafted customer message: "We're seeing elevated load on EU Dedicated pools. We've enabled temporary burst capacity and applied traffic shaping to preserve availability. We're monitoring and will update within 30 minutes." Want me to send to affected customers?

tom (oncall): send it. include link to status and support escalation path.

oliver (product): also capture that rerank and long-stream were gated; add that to the follow-up notes for billing/credits discussion.

elaine (dedicated-eng): toggled rerank off on pool:
```
POST /admin/pools/eu-prod-pool-9/features/disable
{ "features": ["rerank","long_stream"] }
```
elaine (dedicated-eng): response 200. features disabled.

deploy-bot: autoscaler: node count 32/32 (including burst).

tom (oncall): handoff note: I need to step away at 2016000300 for a meeting. yusuf will be primary watch. leaving these checkpoints: 1) if p95 < 500ms for 15m, re-enable long_stream in canary 2) if any tenant hits 50% above normal after caps, escalate to product 3) if cloud quota not confirmed in 15m, prepare to extend burst TTL manually.

yusuf (infra): ack. monitoring dashboards and rate-limiter logs. will follow the checkpoints and post updates.

hannah (support): notified customers. no new P1s.

oliver (product): capture tenant list for later account outreach: tenant-gamma (trigger), tenant-delta, tenant-epsilon. we'll discuss reserved capacity offers.

elaine (dedicated-eng): planned re-enable sequence (canary): 1) enable long_stream on 1 canary node 2) monitor 10m metrics 3) if stable, roll to 10% of pool then full. documenting runbook steps.

tom (oncall): post-incident action items: - open permanent quota ticket with cloud (yusuf) - write burst toggle runbook and exec checklist (elaine) - design tenant-level fairness/auto-throttle policy (infra + product) - update customer-facing Dedicated docs to explain burst behavior and cost (oliver + support)

yusuf (infra): permanent quota ticket submitted.

deploy-bot: MITIGATION_APPLIED: burst enabled, rate-limits and feature gates updated.

yusuf (infra): monitoring shows steady decline in 5xxs; p95 now ~280ms; continuing watch.

thirty_seconds_later: tom (oncall): back and seeing stability. good job.

deploy-bot: RESOLVED: pool eu-prod-pool-9 stabilized; burst expired or was disabled following cooldown.

hannah (support): closing customer notifications; creating postmortem case with links to runbook edits.

tom (oncall): closing thread and assigning postmortem owners. thanks all. :thumbsup:
